## Summary

`validate_a11y` is ~95% tree construction: measured `a11y_tree` = 10.50 ms vs `validate_a11y` = 11.04 ms on S2 (bench/ULTIMO.md:16-17), so the post-build walk + report costs only ≈0.54 ms (≈4.9%). S2 in `bench/benches/hot_path.rs:11-23,77-86` is 10,000 `paragraph` blocks, one 100-byte `text` run each, `Schema::basic()`, empty doc attrs, no IDs, no marks. With that corpus the dominant costs are (a) `DocPath::child` allocating 3–5 times per node with `format!`, (b) the same text copied into 3 `String`/`Box<str>` per paragraph plus 2 per run, (c) one heap `Vec` of one `A11yNode` per block plus un-presized vectors (top-level grows to 10k elements copying ~300-byte nodes), and (d) ~9 schema attribute-name scans per block plus two full schema-mark scans per run. Fixing `DocPath::child` alone removes ~50k alloc/free pairs; together with ready-made vector sizing and the text/attr/mark fixes the estimate is 2.4–4.0 ms (≈22–36%) off both benches, putting validate safely below 10 ms. No gate in the repo asserts allocation counts for a11y, and no golden JSON files exist; assertions constrain paths, ordering, roles and names but not message text.

## Architecture

`Doc` → `Doc::a11y_tree` (tree.rs) walks `Doc::blocks()` (`BlockSeq`/`TopBlockIter`, block_seq.rs:44-110) and calls `build::block_nodes` recursively; every block/run becomes an `A11yNode` with an owned `DocPath` built by `path.child(index)`; schema supplies role/name policies, attr specs (looked up by name each time) and mark roles. `validate_a11y` calls `a11y_tree` first, then recursively walks the materialized tree checking roles/alt/name/levels and collecting `(path, code, args)` issues, sorts them, and drops the tree. `a11y/json.rs` is a second consumer that serializes the same tree (schema declaration order for marks). Consumers outside the crate: WASM `a11y_tree`/`validate_a11y` (crates/rich-editor-auy-wasm/src/lib.rs:102-127) and CLI (cli/src/main.rs:74,96) — so `A11yNode` field types/JSON shape must stay unchanged.

## Report

### 1. Allocation / redundancy ledger (S2 paragraph = 1 block node + 1 run node)

Counts are derived from the code paths ([INFERENCE] on allocator growth details). "N" = per top-level paragraph; S2 = 10,000.

| # | Site | Allocations | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | `DocPath::root().child(i)` tree.rs:106 → pos.rs:187-195 | 3 | `String::from("")` then `push_str(&format!(...))`: growth alloc + `format!` String + `into_boxed_str` shrink realloc. |
| B | run `path.child(i)` build.rs:141 → pos.rs:187-195 | 4–5 | `String::from(parent)`, growth on `push('/')`, growth/`format!` for digits, shrink realloc. |
| C | `child_nodes` `Vec::new` build.rs:122 (Blocks) / :138 (Text) | 1–2 | `A11yNode` ~300 B ⇒ RawVec min cap 4; with len 1, `into_boxed_slice` at :102 shrinks ⇒ extra realloc. |
| D | `block_nodes` `Vec::from([A11yNode])` build.rs:80 | 1 | 1-element Vec, dropped after caller `extend` copies the node again. |
| E | top-level `children` tree.rs:99/102 | ~14 reallocs | No `with_capacity`; relocating 300-B nodes copies ≈2× final = ~6 MB. |
| F | `block_text` build.rs:42 → text.rs:7-13 | 1 | `String::new` + `push_str(100 B)`. |
| G | `text_field = Box::from(text)` build.rs:51-55 | 1 | Second copy of the same 100 B. |
| H | `name_for(TextContent)` build.rs:56,217-232 | 1 | Third copy of the same 100 B per paragraph. |
| I | run `name: Some(Box::from(run.text))` build.rs:152 | 1 | Copy of run text. |
| J | run `text: Some(Box::from(run.text))` build.rs:158 | 1 | Duplicate copy of the same 100 B (both fields observable, cannot drop). |
| K | `marks: run.marks.clone()` build.rs:159 | 0 in S2 | Empty `Box<[MarkAttr]>` clone does not heap-allocate; non-empty mark sets allocate per run. |
| L | `block.id()` build.rs:82 → block.rs:124-129 → ids.rs:53-56 | 0 in S2 | Binary search + `NodeId::new` `Box<str>` only when `id` attr exists. |
| M | `lang.clone()`/`dir.clone()` build.rs:38,130-131,189-190 | 0 in S2 | 2 `Box<str>` allocations **per node** when the document defines `lang`/`dir`. |
| N | tree root/lang/dir clones tree.rs:107-108,113,127-128,136 | 0 in S2 | 2 extra Boxes when doc attrs present. |
| O | validate `ids.insert(id.clone())` validate.rs:96-97 | 0 in S2 | `NodeId` clone (`Box<str>`) per duplicated/anchor node when IDs exist. |
| P | `push` path clone / arg boxes validate.rs:224,105,117,142,155-156 | 0 in S2 | `DocPath` clone + `Box<str>`/`Vec` per issue; only on findings. |
| Q | `A11yIssue` vectors/sort validate.rs:24-26,39-40 | 0 in S2 | Vectors allocate on first issue; empty sorts are no-ops. |

Repeated computations per block/run:

| Site | Repetition |
|---|---|
| build.rs:58-62,75,84,78-79 | 7× `attr_str` + 2× `attr_u16`: each performs `schema.node(kind)` + `spec.attrs.iter().find(name)` + `Attrs::get` (attrs.rs:104). Paragraph spec has 1 attr, full-schema cells ~8, so ~9 scans/block. |
| build.rs:56,68,75,82 | Additional `name_for` find, `level` `attrs.get`, `block.id()` `attrs.get` — same data scanned again. |
| build.rs:57,234-249 | `alt_for` re-finds the `"alt"` attr although `name_for` already resolved `AttrId(1)` (`alt` in basic/full media); media therefore clones the same alt text twice. |
| build.rs:151,160 + marks.rs:24-49 | Two independent full scans of `schema.marks()` per run (6 basic, 12 full); `mark_href` additionally calls `schema.mark(spec.id)` and scans that mark's attrs per present mark. Empty `MarkSet` still pays both scans. |
| build.rs:42-55,56 | Same text converted `String` → `Box` → `Box` three times. |
| build.rs:43-50 + text.rs:15-22 | For `block+` nodes whose direct text is empty and policy is `TextContent` (full-schema `table_cell`, `table_header`), `descendant_text` re-walks the whole subtree that `child_nodes` walks immediately before/after. |
| tree.rs:106,113 | `DocPath::root()` constructed per top-level block and again for the root node. |
| validate.rs:22-23 vs tree.rs | `validate_a11y` builds the entire tree only to walk it; the tree is dropped before returning the report. |
| validate.rs:88-90,208 | `path` parameter always equals `&node.path`; redundant plumbing. |
| role.rs:67-94 | `A11yRole::name()` is `const fn -> &'static str` — **no** role-name allocation in the build path; the only `Box<str>` role name is `Box::from(node.role.name())` when emitting A001 (validate.rs:117). |

### 2. Build vs validate split

| Measurement | Value |
|---|---|
| `a11y_tree` S2, build + teardown of returned tree | 10.50 ms (bench/ULTIMO.md:16) |
| `validate_a11y` S2, build + teardown + walk + report | 11.04 ms (bench/ULTIMO.md:17) |
| Validate-only delta (walk + `validate_root` + report) | ≈0.54 ms ≈ 4.9% |
| Tree construction+drop share of `validate_a11y` | ≈95.1% |

Duplicated traversal: none in S2 beyond the validate re-walk (paragraph blocks have non-empty direct text, so `descendant_text` is not invoked). `DocPath` allocation: `pos.rs:172` (struct), `root` :177-179 (empty string shares the dangling pointer, no heap), `child` :187-195 (all significant allocations), plus `path.clone()` at validate.rs:224 and `lang`/`dir` clones inherited per node. The prior build-time clone was already removed (DIVERGENCES.md:42, 11.34→11.04 ms ≈0.3 ms for one clone per node, i.e. ≈15 ns per alloc+free in this workload — useful calibration for the estimates below).

### 3. Ordered optimization list (no semantics change)

Ordered by ROI/risk. Estimates are [INFERENCE] scaled from the measured 0.3 ms per clone-per-node delta and the allocation counts above.

| # | Edit point | Change | Expected effect on S2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | `pos.rs:187-195` (`DocPath::child`) | Compute digit count into a `[u8; 10]` (backwards loop, no `format!`, no `unwrap`), build `String::with_capacity(parent.len() + sep + digits)` exactly, `push_str(parent)`, `push('/')`, push digit `char`s, then `into_boxed_str()` (capacity == len ⇒ no shrink realloc). Resulting bytes and ordering identical. Removes `format!` temp, growth and shrink reallocs: 3–5 allocs → 1 per node. | ~50k fewer allocs/frees; **1.2–2.0 ms** (11–19%). Highest single win; also benefits `model/validate.rs:292`. |
| O2 | `tree.rs:99` and `build.rs:26,38-40,80,112-137,148,170,204` | (a) `Vec::with_capacity(self.blocks().len())` for the root children; hoist `let root = DocPath::root();` at tree.rs:99 and reuse at :106/:113. (b) `Vec::with_capacity(children.len())` / `items.len()` in `child_nodes` (:122, :138). (c) Change `block_nodes`/`child_nodes` to append into a caller-provided `&mut Vec<A11yNode>` (`out`) instead of returning a Vec; for a node with `a11y`, build `children` into a fresh Vec, then `out.push(A11yNode { children: children.into_boxed_slice(), .. })`; for `a11y == None`, recurse directly into `out`. Removes the one-element `Vec::from([node])` and its copy. | Eliminates ~14 top-level reallocs (~6 MB memcpy) and 10k one-element Vec alloc+copy+free: **0.4–0.8 ms** (4–7%). |
| O3 | `text.rs:7-13`; `build.rs:42,51-56`; optionally `model/text.rs` helper | Add `TextBlock::text_owned()`/`block_text_boxed` that builds `String::with_capacity(inner.len().0 as usize)` and returns `Box<str>` (or keep `String` but pass `into_boxed_str()` directly into `text_field`). Then `name_for` for `TextContent` derives from `text_field.as_deref()` rather than the temporary `text`, i.e. `text_field = (!text.is_empty()).then_some(text)` and `name = text_field.clone()` path. Also skip `block_text` entirely when the block is not a text block (return empty cheaply). | One fewer alloc + 100-B copy per text block: **0.2–0.4 ms** (2–4%). |
| O4 | `build.rs:56-79,217-276`; put the helper in a new `a11y/attrs.rs` (build.rs is ~289 lines) | Resolve the 10 known attribute names once per node kind (ideally once per document into a small `[[Option<AttrId>; N]]` indexed by `NodeKind`, or at least one `for attr in &spec.attrs` pass per block filling `href/src/caption/transcript/language/scope/colspan/rowspan/description/alt/name/level` slots). Then all fields become a single `attrs.get(id)` per slot. Replaces 7× `attr_str` + 2× `attr_u16` + `name_for`/`alt_for`/`level`/`id` name scans (≈9 `str` comparisons + `schema.node` calls per block in S2, more in full schema). | **0.3–0.6 ms** (3–5%); also removes duplicate alt/name resolution for media. |
| O5 | `marks.rs:24-49`, `build.rs:151,160` | In `child_nodes`, `if run.marks.is_empty()` set `role = A11yRole::Text`, `href = None` before scanning. For non-empty sets, replace the two independent `schema.marks()` loops with one loop returning `(role, href)`, using `marks.iter_attrs()`/`mark_id` instead of `schema.mark(spec.id)` re-lookup in `mark_href`. | S2: skips 2×6 mark iterations + `contains` per run, **0.2–0.3 ms** (2–3%); also halves work on marked documents. |
| O6 | `validate.rs:88-95,208` | Drop the redundant `path` parameter; use `&node.path` inside `validate_node` (top-level call tree.rs path = child.path already). No alloc change, slightly less code/plumbing. | <0.05 ms; cleanliness. |
| O7 | `validate.rs:96-97` (optional) | Use `BTreeSet<&str>` borrowed from `node.id` (`id.as_str()`) instead of cloning `NodeId`, and only build the set lazily. Avoids one `Box<str>` alloc per identified node. | 0 in S2; latent for ID-heavy docs. Keep BTreeSet: IDs are not sorted in tree order, and duplicate detection requires `(path, code)` sorting only at the end. |
| O8 | `validate.rs:22-23` (fallback only) | If more headroom is ever needed: validate directly while walking `Doc`+schema (no `A11yTree` materialization) or refactor build to an internal visitor invoked by both `a11y_tree` and `validate_a11y` (single traversal, no duplicated policy logic). Estimated validate → ~1–2 ms, but duplicates role/name/alt/level/list/table logic — higher divergence risk; **not required** once O1–O5 land. | est. −80–90% but risky. |

Cumulative estimate for O1–O5: **≈2.3–4.1 ms** off (`validate_a11y` ≈ 7.0–8.7 ms, i.e. 21–37% below today and 13–30% under the 10 ms target); `a11y_tree` drops by the same absolute amount. O1 + O2 alone likely suffice for the ≥10% requirement.

Constraints to respect while implementing: files ≤300 lines (extract `a11y/attrs.rs`), no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` (use `unwrap_or`, digit loops, `char::from`), deterministic byte-identical paths/order, no new dependencies, and no change to public `A11yNode`/`A11yRole`/`DocPath` types (json.rs, WASM, CLI consume them). `build.rs` also retains its `too_many_arguments` allowances; the sink refactor naturally reduces arguments.

### 4. Tests/goldens constraining this work

No golden JSON files exist under `crates/rich-editor-auy/tests/` (only the source assertions below).

| File | Asserts |
|---|---|
| `tests/a11y.rs:17-31` | Complete document (`lang=pt-BR`, paragraph) validates with no a11y errors. |
| `tests/a11y.rs:34-49` | A001 for image without alt; **exact path `"0"`** (:48) — constrains top-level `DocPath` bytes. |
| `tests/a11y.rs:52-68` | A003 for heading with level 2 and no text; **exact path `"0"`** (:67). |
| `tests/a11y.rs:71-74` | Empty `bullet_list` is rejected at parse (structural, not a11y). |
| `tests/a11y.rs:77-99` | Tree order: `root.children.first()` is paragraph, `paragraph.children.first()` is the run; run role `link` via `role.name()` (:93), `href` (:94-97); validate ok. |
| `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs:11-36` | `raw_code` is the first child, role `CodeBlock`, `code_language=="sql"`, `text=="select 1;"`, first child role `Text` with the same text; validate ok. |
| `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs:39-69` | Figure projection order/count (2 figures) and first child role `Image`. |
| `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs:72-98` | `ordered_list` → `ordered==Some(true)`, `bullet_list` → `Some(false)`, in document order. |
| `tests/schema_full_a11y.rs:101-144` | Table hierarchy/order: `table.children.first()` row, `row.children[0]` is `TableCell{header:true}`, its first child `Paragraph`, `header.name=="Head"`; `row.children[1]` is `TableCell{header:false}` with name `"Value"`. |
| `tests/smoke.rs:51-67` | Root has exactly 1 child, first role `Paragraph`; tree JSON contains `"role":"document"`, `"role":"paragraph"`, and `"marks":["strong"]` (marks emitted in schema declaration order). |
| `tests/schema_full_attrs.rs:106-107` | Full-schema document with metadata passes `validate_a11y` (no issue shape assertions). |
| `tests/schema_full.rs:78` | Schema-level role for `raw_code` (not tree). |
| `plan/04_arquitetura.md:485-486`, `plan/07_rigor.md:734-735` | Documentary contract: I18 deterministic reading order/ranges/names; I19 one case per `A11yCode` with path/range (messages are localized outside the core, so no message-text goldens). |

No test asserts `A11yArg` payload text, `A11yIssue` JSON, or allocation counts for a11y (`tests/alloc.rs` does not touch a11y).

### 5. Does `a11y_tree` alone exceed the 10 ms budget?

`a11y_tree` = 10.50 ms S2, which is above the 10 ms figure, but that 10 ms is documented only for `validate_a11y`/`validate`; `a11y_tree` has no numeric target — plan/05_desempenho.md:67-73 defines it as on-demand render/validation-budget work that "aloca por nó", explicitly not the keystroke gate. So there is no violated documented budget, but tree cost is the whole reason validate misses 10 ms. Existing measurements:

| Source | Numbers |
|---|---|
| bench/ULTIMO.md:11-17 | S2: `apply` 2.89 µs, `to_json_string` 1.12 ms, `from_json` 20.87 ms, `a11y_tree` 10.50 ms, `validate_a11y` 11.04 ms (target ≤10 ms, state "acima"). |
| bench/COMPLEX-COMPARISON.md:36-40 | Full-typology corpus (3,000 blocks): `validate` 4.44 ms, `a11y_tree` 10.10 ms, `validate_a11y` 10.92 ms. |
| DIVERGENCES.md:63 (§D) | `validate_a11y` ~11.04 ms vs 10 ms; remediation stated as "Revisar alocações `DocPath`/texto por nó e cachear a árvore no adaptador". |
| DIVERGENCES.md:42 (row 32) | Moving `DocPath` into the node instead of cloning: 11.34 → 11.04 ms (calibration for O1–O3 estimates). |
| bench/ULTIMO.md:40-48 | Allocation profile exists only for `apply`/`apply_owned` (35/25 allocs), not for a11y. |

### Critical Files for Implementation
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/pos.rs` — `DocPath::child` (:187-195): single-allocation path construction (O1).
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/a11y/build.rs` — per-node allocation sites and repeated attr/mark/text work (O2–O5); keep under 300 lines, extract helpers.
- `crates/rich-editor-auy/src/a11y/tree.rs` — top-level traversal, un-presized children vector, per-block `DocPath::root()` (:96-1…
